data.title: Mortgage Partnership Finance® Program Expands Traditional Product Guidelines to Support Affordable and Sustainable Homeownership
data.description: In Chicago, the Mortgage Partnership Finance® (MPF®) Program has broadened eligibility for its MPF Traditional products, allowing FHLBank member financial institutions to sell more qualifying mortgages. This expansion supports affordable and sustainable homeownership by including mortgages from affordable lending programs, loans for manufactured homes, home improvement and renovation financing, and lender-funded affordable initiatives. The move aims to diversify the eligible mortgage types, benefiting a wider range of borrowers.

data.title: Novartis receives positive CHMP opinion for Cosentyx® in polymyalgia rheumatica (PMR)
data.description: Novartis announced today that the CHMP of the EMA has recommended marketing authorization for Cosentyx (secukinumab) in treating polymyalgia rheumatica (PMR) in adults. This opinion supports Cosentyx use for PMR in individuals who have not responded well to steroids or who relapse during steroid taper. If approved, Cosentyx would be the first IL-17A inhibitor approved in Europe for PMR, a condition with limited advanced treatment choices. This development addresses the need for better treatment options in PMR, impacting a significant number of individuals in the region.

data.title: Warren Buffett Steps Down As Chairman Of Berkshire Hathaway, Ending Legendary Career
data.description: Warren Buffett, the renowned leader of Berkshire Hathaway, has revealed his decision to resign as chairman, which is effective immediately. After a successful and legendary career, Buffett's departure marks a significant change for the company and its shareholders. This transition signifies the end of an era for Berkshire Hathaway and leaves many wondering what the future holds for the company. Warren Buffett's impact and influence during his time as chairman have been remarkable, and his departure will undoubtedly have a lasting impact on the company's trajectory. This news has garnered attention and speculation from investors and the business community at large.

data.title: gategroup Celebrates Lufthansa’s Award-Winning First Class Culinary Experience
data.description: Lufthansa was honored with the title of "World’s Best First Class Onboard Dining" at the 2026 Skytrax World Airline Awards held in Zurich on Friday, September 18. This recognition highlights the airline's collaboration with gategourmet Germany and the successful introduction of its innovative Future Onboard Experience (FOX) initiative. The award signifies Lufthansa's commitment to providing exceptional dining experiences for its passengers and underscores its leading position in the aviation industry. This achievement showcases Lufthansa's dedication to delivering top-notch services, solidifying its reputation as a premier airline.
